data.body: Cite re-verification against origin/main 360d504f5ceb (2026-09-07). `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py` shrank 674 -> 631 lines since 083620b0 (nine hunks, cumulative -19 to -43). Description corrections (old -> new): `main()` `:506-670` -> `:475-627`; pause `:566` -> `:531` (`pause_exit = _pause_exit_code(...)`); lock-file purge `:575` -> `:538` (`_purge_committed_reconciler_locks`); pass-lock check/steal/acquire `:588-630` -> `:545-587` (`_post_pause_preflight` through `acquired = True`); heartbeat + `abort_check` `:631-642` -> `:588-599`; `finalize_process`/`release_process_lock` `:657-668` -> `:614-625`; `run_pass_result` `:346` -> `:327` (`def run_pass_result`); basis 083620b0 -> 360d504f5ceb. Unchanged on the tip: `_lib_ops.py:213-248` (`_bridge_run`), `_mcp_reads.py:85-99` (`bridge_sync`), `last_pass.py:376` (`exit_code == 75`). Note: the basis sentence's parenthetical "engine paths are under `src/rebar/reconciler/` after the package move" is not yet true on the tip: the package move (dependency gunshy-symmetric-barnacle, bf96-5776-6a97-420f) is still open, so every cite above is against `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py`.
